field.name: YourID
field.description: Mã chứng từ phía đối tác

field.name: CustomerID
field.check: ma_kh not in (select ma_kh from dmkh where status = '1')

field.name: ItemID
field.check: ma_vt not in (select ma_vt from dmvt where status = '1')

query.text:
-- Dự án thay đoạn dưới bằng proc ghi chứng từ, vd: exec restApi_ProcessDataFor_m81 @@voucherCode, @@unit, @@userId SELECT 'SUCCESS' AS code, '' AS message, 'master,detail' AS tables
SELECT a.id_doitac AS YourID, @@unit AS UnitCode, @@voucherCode AS VoucherCode, a.ngay_ct AS VoucherDate, RTRIM(a.ma_kh) AS CustomerID, b.ten_kh AS CustomerName, a.ong_ba AS Buyer, a.dien_giai AS Note, (SELECT SUM(c.so_luong * c.gia_nt2) FROM #detail c WHERE c._parent = a._parent) AS TotalAmount FROM #master a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON b.ma_kh = a.ma_kh ORDER BY a._row
SELECT a.id_doitac AS YourID, a._row + 1 AS LineNo, RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS ItemID, a.km_yn AS Promotion, a.so_luong AS Quantity, a.gia_nt2 AS Price, a.so_luong * a.gia_nt2 AS Amount FROM #detail a ORDER BY a._parent, a._row
